sloka: संशयस्थमिदं सर्वं शत्रोः प्रतिसमासने।एकस्य गमनं तत्र नहि मे रोचते भृशम् ।। ६.६४.१६ ।।
transliteration: saṁśayasthamidaṁ sarvaṁ śatroḥ pratisamāsane।ekasya gamanaṁ tatra nahi me rocate bhṛśam ।। 6.64.16 ।।

translations.english: "Face to face with the enemy this total army will be in danger. You're going alone is certainly not desirable."
